name: Lythazossa
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #221: Into the Apocalypse Archive

generalAbilities.name: Remove a Condition
generalAbilities.description:
Cost 1 Mythic Point

Effect Lythazossa ends one condition affecting her.

savenote: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

defensiveAbilities.name: Mythic Resilience (Reflex)
defensiveAbilities.description: The creature treats its saving throws with the associated save as one degree of success better than it rolled. This is not cumulative with other effects that change their degree of success, like the incapacitation trait (except for rolling a natural 1 or 20). Each time the monster gains mythic resilience, choose one save. The ability should apply to the creature's highest saves first.

defensiveAbilities.name: Reactive Strike (Spectral Tail Only)
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

defensiveAbilities.name: Rejuvenation
defensiveAbilities.description: When Lythazossa is destroyed, she re-forms after 2d4 days in the Prosperity Vault, fully healed. She can be permanently destroyed if the apocalypse seed is removed from Varisia.

defensiveAbilities.name: Undying Myth
defensiveAbilities.description:
Cost all of Lythazossa's Mythic Points

Trigger Lythazossa would be destroyed and has at least 1 Mythic Point

Effect Lythazossa remains active, and recovers 140 Healing Damage Hit Points.

defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Calamitous Roar
offensiveAbilities.description:
Lythazossa laments her cursed fate. Each living creature within 30 feet attempts a DC 42 Will Saving Throw save with the following results.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and is temporarily immune to Calamitous Roar for 1 minute.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature becomes Frightened 2

Critical Failure The creature becomes Frightened 3

offensiveAbilities.name: Recharge
offensiveAbilities.description:
Cost 1 Mythic Point

Effect Lythazossa can use Soul-Melting Breath again.

offensiveAbilities.name: Reroll
offensiveAbilities.description:
Cost 1 Mythic Point

Trigger Lythazossa fails a check

Effect Lythazossa rerolls the check.

offensiveAbilities.name: Soul-Melting Breath
offensiveAbilities.description: Lythazossa expels a 60ft Type:cone of ghostly acid that melts a creature's very soul, dealing 20d6 Spirit Damage damage to creatures in the area (Basic DC 42 Will Saving Throw save). The ghostly acid also saps the life from affected creatures. At the beginning of Lythazossa's next turn, each creature that failed the Reflex save must succeed at a Basic DC 42 Fortitude Saving Throw save or become Drained 1 (Drained 2 on a critical failure). Lythazossa can't use Soul-Melting Breath again for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Telekinetic Assault
offensiveAbilities.description: Lythazossa cries out in pain and anguish, hurling small objects and debris is a 30ft Type:emanation. Creatures in the area take 10d6 Bludgeoning Damage damage (Basic DC 42 Reflex Saving Throw save).

offensiveAbilities.name: Vestige of an Ancient Curse
offensiveAbilities.description: When Lythazossa hits a creature with her jaws Strike, the target must succeed at a DC 42 Will Saving Throw save or become Enfeebled 2 until Lythazossa's spirit is put to rest. If the target critically fails this saving throw, Lythazossa regains 40 HP, and the target is instead Enfeebled 3.

lv9spells.name: Unfettered Movement (Constant)
lv9spells.description: You repel effects that would hinder a creature or slow its movement. While under this spell's effect, the target ignores effects that would give them a circumstance penalty to Speed. When they attempt to Escape an effect that has them Immobilized, Grabbed, or Restrained, they automatically succeed unless the effect is magical and of a higher rank than the unfettered movement spell.

lv9spells.name: Truesight (Constant)
lv9spells.description: You see things within 60 feet as they actually are. The GM rolls a secret counteract check against any illusion, morph or polymorph effect in the area, but only for the purpose of determining whether you see through it (for instance, if the check succeeds against a polymorph spell, you can see the creature's true form, but you don't end the polymorph spell).
